calendar.climate_note: Edinburgh's cool maritime climate and high latitude delay spring budburst and prolong autumn leaf drop.

stages.budburst: Bright green leaf tips emerge from large buds; pendulous yellow-green racemes expand.
stages.full_leaf: Dense canopy of broad, dark green palmate leaves; hanging green winged samaras form.
stages.colouring: Coarse foliage turns dull yellow to golden brown; winged keys mature to woody brown.
stages.peak: Uneven golden-brown and tawny canopy; heavy shedding of dry samaras begins.
stages.falling: Canopy rapidly thins; thick grey limbs and peeling bark increasingly exposed.
stages.dormant: Completely bare; heavy-limbed framework, plate-like bark, and plump green buds visible.

stages.budburst: Tender pale green shoots emerge; vigorous leafy suckers sprout at trunk bases.
stages.full_leaf: Dense heart-shaped green leaves form heavy ovate canopy; fragrant cream cymes in July.
stages.colouring: Leaves fade to pale yellow; small nutlets hang from dried pale leafy bracts.
stages.peak: Uniform bright buttery-yellow canopy; dense epicormic base shoots also yellowing.
stages.falling: Canopy thins rapidly; upper crown exposed while lower suckers hold yellow leaves.
stages.dormant: Entirely bare canopy showing dense dark crown and thick sprout clusters around base.

stages.budburst: Small brownish-red flowers precede rough, emerging folded green leaf clusters.
stages.full_leaf: Large, rough, deep green asymmetric leaves form a dense, broad upright canopy.
stages.colouring: Foliage shifts to dull yellow and ochre; disc-shaped dry samaras mostly dropped.
stages.peak: Vibrant golden-yellow to russet crown; leaf margins curl and brown.
stages.falling: Scattered yellow leaves; stout upright and arching branch architecture revealed.
stages.dormant: Leafless; rugged dark grey fissured bark and sweeping branches fully visible.

stages.budburst: Tiny bright green leaves unfurl alongside dangling brownish-yellow male catkins.
stages.full_leaf: Airy, weeping canopy of shimmering triangular green leaves; silvery-white bark.
stages.colouring: Fine leaves fade to lime green and clear yellow across pendulous branch tips.
stages.peak: Luminous golden-yellow weeping crown contrasting against stark white trunks.
stages.falling: Sparse golden foliage; fine weeping reddish-brown twigs dominate canopy.
stages.dormant: Leafless; delicate weeping twig spray and silvery-white trunks prominent.
